fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' orders all {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}} to dash toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through as well as those in front of them upon arrival, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 25% for 1 second.
fields.description2: Enemies hit by subsequent soldiers take no additional damage or {{tip|slow}}.
fields.description3: ''A summoned {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} is required to cast this ability.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
